title: Hockey Card Collection
description: Schema for hockey card collection data. Supports both a direct map of set identifiers to sets and the repository's dataset wrapper format.

setMap.description: Map whose property names are unique set identifiers.

datasetDocument.description: Dataset document containing collection metadata and a map of sets.

dataset.description: Stable identifier for the dataset, such as mario-lemieux.

player.description: Primary player represented by the dataset.

updated_at.description: ISO-formatted date on which the dataset was last updated.

image_folder.description: Root folder used for card images in this dataset.

sets.description: Map of unique set identifiers to set objects.

set.description: A complete card release, including its base cards and optional subsets.

set_key.description: Unique identifier for the set, normally a lowercase slug.

set_name.description: Manufacturer or product name of the set without the year prefix.

set_year_label.description: Human-readable hockey season label, such as 2026-27.

set_year_start.description: First calendar year in the hockey season represented by the set.

set_year_end.description: Last calendar year in the hockey season represented by the set.

set_display_name.description: Full display label for the set, usually including the season and product name.

menu_display_name.description: Optional shorter label used in navigation menus.

set_category.description: Optional navigation category used to group related sets.

set_variation.description: Optional variation label for the set.

set_total_cards.description: Optional number of cards in the complete set checklist.

set_tcdb_href.description: Trading Card Database set URL, or an empty string when no link is available.

_parent_key.description: Optional internal identifier for the parent set of a nested set record.

source.description: Optional source or provenance label for the set.

cards.description: Base cards belonging directly to this set.

subsets.description: Insert, parallel, autograph, relic, or other subsets within this set.

subset.description: A named secondary release belonging to a parent set.

set_name.description: Name of the subset, parallel, or insert.

set_type.description: Optional classification of the subset, such as parallel or insert.

set_display_name.description: Full display label for the subset.

set_year_label.description: Optional season label stored on a legacy subset record.

set_year_start.description: Optional start year stored on a legacy subset record.

set_year_end.description: Optional end year stored on a legacy subset record.

set_tcdb_href.description: Trading Card Database subset URL, or an empty string when no link is available.

card.description: An individual hockey card and its collection metadata.

id.description: Globally stable card identifier used for routes and data lookups.

base_number.description: Card number as printed on the card, including prefixes or letters.

name.description: Name of the player or subject shown on the card.

team.description: Team or national program represented by the card.

position.description: Player position represented by the card.

variant_note.description: Optional human-readable note describing a variant or special designation.

default_face.description: Optional default face used when displaying a two-sided card.

orientation_front.description: Orientation of the card front image.

orientation_back.description: Orientation of the card back image.

orientation.description: Legacy shared orientation for card images.

image_front.description: URL or repository-relative path for the front image; use an empty string when unavailable.

image_back.description: URL or repository-relative path for the back image; use an empty string when unavailable.

tcdb_href.description: Trading Card Database card URL, or an empty string when no link is available.

serial_total.description: Total production limit for a serial-numbered card, such as 250; null means not serial-numbered.

serial_number.description: Optional specific serial number printed on the card.

inCollection.description: Whether this card is currently owned in the collection.

price.description: Optional estimated market value of the card.

last_seen_price.description: Optional most recently observed market price.

insert_subset.description: Optional subset name associated with the card.

isRookie.description: Whether the card is a rookie card.

is_image_placeholder.description: Whether the image is a temporary placeholder.

set_display_name.description: Optional set display label stored on legacy card records.

set_name.description: Optional set name stored on legacy card records.

set_variation.description: Optional set variation stored on legacy card records.

set_year_label.description: Optional set year label stored on legacy card records.

set_year_start.description: Optional set start year stored on legacy card records.

set_year_end.description: Optional set end year stored on legacy card records.

_parent_key.description: Optional parent set identifier stored on legacy card records.

_set_key.description: Optional set identifier stored on legacy card records.

excludeFromBinder.description: Whether the card should be excluded from binder views.
